visual.name: advanVisSmartWaterfall
visual.description: Waterfall and bridge charts that add up and explain themselves in plain English. Free: steps from a category or from several measures, subtotals found for you or added where you want them, costs subtracted so the subtotals add up, a period bridge with a breakdown, Top N with Other, sorting by impact, a marked axis break so small steps stay visible, columns or bars, value and % labels, connectors, conditional formatting, drill-down, vector export and a basic headline. Pro (one-month free trial): a budget-to-actual or last-year bridge from two measures, the total change marker, the full smart headline and findings with How calculated, and smart design tips.
